Description: A retired train driver and his granddaughter race across Kerala during the monsoon to deliver a letter before a village is flooded.
A young software engineer in Chennai discovers that her startup's app is secretly tracking users and must decide whether to blow the whistle.
An underdog village kabaddi team trains under a strict former champion to win the state tournament and save their school ground.
A detective investigates a series of temple jewellery thefts that all happen during festival nights.
A lonely boy builds a robot from scrap parts and the robot accidentally becomes a cricket coach for the local team.
A family of fishermen fights a powerful company that wants to turn their beach into a private port.
Engineering students move into a cheap hostel and find that the previous tenant, a friendly ghost, wants help passing his exams.
An epic historical drama about traders who carry pepper and cardamom across the sea and the rivalry between two port cities.
Two developers who hate each other on an online forum unknowingly fall in love while working at the same company.
A team of retired bank employees plans a careful robbery of the bank that cheated them out of their pensions.
A city doctor moves to a remote hill village with no hospital and slowly earns the trust of the people.
Street racers in a futuristic city compete in illegal night races while a police officer goes undercover among them.
A cooking competition brings together a grandmother and her estranged grandson, who must cook together to win.
Astronauts on the first crewed mission to Mars lose contact with Earth and must survive with failing equipment.
A ten-year-old girl from a small town becomes a chess grandmaster while her father struggles to pay for tournaments.
A village blacksmith takes on a gang of smugglers that controls the valley, leading to a massive action-packed showdown.
